name: MagicMirror Dev
postStartCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/playwright-mcp /root/.claude /root/.ssh; chmod 700 /root/.ssh; if [ -f /tmp/host-claude/.credentials.json ]; then cp /tmp/host-claude/.credentials.json /root/.claude/.credentials.json && chmod 600 /root/.claude/.credentials.json; fi; if [ -d /tmp/host-ssh ]; then cp -rL /tmp/host-ssh/. /root/.ssh/ 2>/dev/null; find /root/.ssh -type f -exec chmod 600 {} +; fi; if ! grep -q "^github.com " /root/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null; then ssh-keyscan -t rsa,ecdsa,ed25519 github.com >> /root/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if [ -f /tmp/host-gitconfig ]; then for k in user.name user.email; do if [ -z "$(git config --global --get $k 2>/dev/null)" ]; then v="$(git config --file /tmp/host-gitconfig --get $k 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$v" ] && git config --global $k "$v"; fi; done; fi; git config --global --get user.email >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "No git identity - commits will fail; run: git config --global user.email <you>"; echo 'Devcontainer started. App at http://localhost:8080'
